extra_development_seeds.purpose: F1 dataset generation (Group E extra seeds for positive-label diversity)

split_rationale: Seed 18 moved from calibration to training: it was the sole positive-label source in v1 but was excluded from gradient training. Extra seeds 1001-1020 all go to training to maximise positive-label coverage. Calibration retains seeds 19-20 (positive-free but structurally diverse).

format.raw: UTF-8 tab-separated rows with one frozen header; no quoting
format.aggregate: raw per-seed files plus one zstd-compressed concatenation
format.float_format: decimal with 9 significant digits, parsed as float32
format.sequence_encoding: lower-upper pairs separated by semicolons; present only when final_count <= 45

feature_columns: f000 through f100 in features-v2 index order

instrumentation.enabled_only_by: MERICANII_DATASET_PATH absolute path plus MERICANII_DATASET_SEED matching ec.rand.seed
instrumentation.sentinel_requirement: instrumentation-off and instrumentation-on produce identical 50200 evaluations, final sequence, and final size for seed 1
